candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment to set MinSum to _val + 1 instead of _val.
Delete the statement that assigns MinSum, so MinSum remains unchanged after the call.
Invert the reentrancy guard check so the modifier requires locked_ to be true, causing SetMinSum to revert and leave MinSum unset.
Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum never changes state.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum = MinSum + _val;` so the value accumulates instead of being assigned.
Delete the guard statement `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetLogFile can still change Log even after initialization.
Delete the assignment `Log = LogFile(_log);` so the Log state variable is never set and remains address(0).
Delete `locked_ = false;` from the end of the modifier so the lock is never released and a second SetLogFile call reverts, leaving Log at its earlier value.
Replace `intitalized = true;` with `intitalized = false;` so calling Initialized() no longer marks the contract as initialized (SetMinSum/SetLogFile remain callable).
Delete the statement `intitalized = true;` so Initialized() becomes a no-op and the contract is never marked initialized.

candidates.change_summary: Remove the line that adds msg.value to the caller's stored balance, so Put no longer credits the deposit.
Replace the guarded unlockTime extension with an unconditional assignment so the unlock time can also be shortened.
Change the value recorded in the log message from msg.value to _lockTime.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call so a Put no longer produces a log entry.
Remove the require(!locked_) check so the nonReentrant_ guard no longer blocks reentrant calls, enabling reentrant Put to change observable state.
Change the MinSum check from >= to > so withdrawal at exactly MinSum is no longer allowed.
Change the balance check from >= to > so withdrawing the entire balance is no longer allowed.
Move the balance subtraction before the external call so the balance is decremented even when the transfer fails.
Log msg.value instead of _am in the Collect message, changing the observable History entries.
Delete the reset of locked_ at the end of the modifier so the contract stays locked after the first guarded call.
